name: correct
purpose: Find repeated repository mistake classes and prevent recurrence through architecture, types, lint or CI, tests, then judgment rules.
triggers: An operator correction to a repeated repository mistake
inputs: Recent commits, reverts, review comments, agent instruction files and workaround comments
Current correction and authorized repository scope
outputs: Repository enforcement changes and real past-mistake checks when authorized
Rule/enforcement table changes after review and explicit permission
Each class with evidence, chosen enforcement level and why higher levels did not work
capabilityLimits: Unavailable or unauthorized writes, execution or CI reduce the workflow to findings and proposals
Durable skill and agent instruction edits require review and explicit permission; commits and external actions require authorization
Host behavior has not been tested
Preserve disable-model-invocation metadata without assuming host enforcement.
ordinaryExample: Use /correct to investigate two reverted changes that copied the same unsafe state owner, then propose one owner and prove the old mistake fails.
